_note: A project-references solution root is checked as written, as svelte-check checks it: its overlay extends the solution, which lists no sources, so no component is type-checked, and the solution's references are carried into the overlay, where the compiler rejects each non-composite referenced project (TS6306, reported on svelte-check's overlay path at the reference's line). Every app's components still count toward the denominator. Verified against svelte-check --tsgo.
